nested_control_plan.scope: Unique smallest measured compact two-value enclosure; other enclosures retain unknown roles. Action semantics and distant effects unconfirmed.

no_visible_effect_contract.meaning: An exact point command with no visible pixel change and no official progress closes only this measured probe. Selection and impossibility remain unacquired; an invisible control remains unknown. Retain epoch, observation evidence, full frame, motif, point and payload. Reject the same offer while these premises remain unchanged. Re-examine other declared composition families; no unscoped input fallback is licensed by this return. A click-to-motion experiment needs its own explicit hypothesis, current binding and falsifier.

point_support.scope: Current measured control/envelope, exact full-frame and epoch guard. Unknown response seals this one-action experiment; no capacity or terminal law supplied.

point_binding.scope: Current measured control/envelope, exact full-frame and epoch guard. Unknown response seals this one-action experiment; no capacity or terminal law supplied.

compositions.open_question: Test the unique smallest measured compact solid core within a measured closed two-value square enclosure. Its control role is hypothetical.
